title: Cash-Out Limits and Arrival Times by Pocketwire Personal Account Plan
content:
Cash-outs move money from the Pocketwire Personal Account balance to a linked bank account (standard transfer) or a linked debit card (instant transfer). Their limits and timing are set per plan.

| Plan | Cash-outs available | Daily cash-out limit (USD, standard and instant together, per Eastern Time calendar day) | Maximum single instant cash-out (USD) | Latest arrival of a standard cash-out (business days after initiation) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pocketwire Lite | No | 0.00 | 0.00 | 3 |
| Pocketwire Core | Yes | 5000.00 | 5000.00 | 3 |
| Pocketwire Plus | Yes | 10000.00 | 10000.00 | 3 |
| Pocketwire Prime | Yes | 15000.00 | 10000.00 | 2 |
| Pocketwire Onyx | Yes | 25000.00 | 25000.00 | 2 |
| Pocketwire Summit | Yes | 50000.00 | 50000.00 | 1 |

### Column meanings

- **Cash-outs available** — whether the plan may transfer balance out to a linked bank account or debit card at all.
- **Daily cash-out limit** — the cap on the sum of cash-outs, standard and instant, initiated on one calendar day, Eastern Time.
- **Maximum single instant cash-out** — the largest amount one instant cash-out may carry.
- **Latest arrival of a standard cash-out** — the number of business days after initiation by which a standard cash-out arrives at the latest.

### Notes

- Pocketwire Prime is the one plan whose maximum single instant cash-out (10000.00) is lower than its daily cash-out limit (15000.00).
- A standard cash-out arrives within 3 business days on Pocketwire Lite, Pocketwire Core and Pocketwire Plus, 2 on Pocketwire Prime and Pocketwire Onyx, and 1 on Pocketwire Summit.
